annotations.title: Create an API key on your account

description: Makes a new key on your own account, for example a narrower one for a helper. scopes defaults to the calling key's scopes and may never be wider. Works in trial (up to 5 live keys); while the owner has not verified, every key is still cut to trial scopes. The secret is returned once: store it. space "team" makes a team key (teams only): it is revoked if you leave the team.

space.description: "personal" (the default): yours, and it goes where you go. "team": made in your team's space; it stays with the team if you leave, and a team key is revoked when you do.

name: create_key

api_key.description: Store it now. It is never shown again.

prefix.description: The first characters of the key, to tell keys apart. The secret is never shown again.
